notes: Direct HTTP (curl/curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) and headless+headed Playwright all returned PerimeterX 403 'Access to this page has been denied' on every URL including robots.txt-allowed sitemap.xml; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, so escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (successful, used for entire extraction). Checked: full main nav (Labor Day Sale, New Arrivals, The Edit, Home, Lighting, Fashion, Beauty, Personalization, Collaborations, Gifts) and their sub-pages; the Home/Home Decor category Refine filter panel (Category + Product Type facets, no Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/holiday terms present); full site sitemap.xml (fetched via browser, ~240 category/CMS URLs) grepped for christmas, holiday, diwali, halloween, valentine, easter, thanksgiving, new-year, festive, hanukkah, seasonal - matched only 4 URLs; site search for 'christmas' and 'holiday' (non-discriminating - 'christmas' returned a 'did you mean christian' fallback with one incidental stationery product, 'holiday' returned unrelated sconces/lamps/book, confirming search is not proof of absence but also surfaced no dedicated category). Of the 4 sitemap matches, 3 are under /edit/ (Holiday Table, Holiday Entertaining, New Year's Eve Entertaining) which resolve to 'The Edit' editorial/blog section and currently show 'THERE ARE NO RESULTS FOR *' (empty, non-PLP, excluded as editorial). The 4th, /gifts/all-holiday-gifts/, is a genuine Magento category PLP (own URL, Refine facets, paginated product grid) - included. Applying the same PLP test to the sibling /gifts/ pages found two more genuine seasonal PLPs: Mother's Day Gifts and Father's Day Gift Guide (both in the seasonal discovery vocabulary as valid 'other seasonal events'). Also checked and excluded /gifts/mayflower-inspired/ (Mayflower Inn & Spa hotel-partnership theme, not a holiday/season, and also empty). No Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Valentine's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, or Indian-festival product categories exist anywhere on the site - Aerin (luxury tabletop/home/fashion/beauty brand) has no dedicated seasonal decor line; its only seasonal taxonomy is three general cross-category gift-guide PLPs (Holiday, Mother's Day, Father's Day) spanning its normal Home Decor/Tabletop/Fashion/Beauty/Lighting inventory rather than holiday-specific product types.
